settings.hint: Tokens the narration itself may spend. Thinking is paid for separately below, so this floor is never eaten by deliberation. A full turn — prose, three choices, mood — measured 172 tokens.
settings.label: Room to answer

settings.hint: Extra tokens granted for reasoning, ON TOP of the answer's. A thinking model needs room to think as well as room to speak; give it one budget for both and the thought eats the sentence. Measured here at 1753–2997 tokens of thinking per turn, so 3200 covers it. Ignored entirely when thinking is off.
settings.label: Room to think

settings.hint: On feeds the live reasoning panel, and thinking is most of the turn: 106–189 seconds measured here, against 17–21 with it truly off. Turning it off may change nothing — a narration turn is schema-constrained, and that route ignores this setting. Only switching structured output off frees it, and that costs the authored choices and live streaming.
settings.label: Let it think out loud
